paragraphs: Rav Gaza. In chapter Chavit, 145b, and chapter Hacholetz, 45b, he said, “Rabbi Yose bar Avin and Rabbi Yose bar Zevida visited our place” (requires examination). Rav Yosef brought an incident involving him. He said to Rav Sheshet and to Ravina. Rav Tachlifa was his son.
